metadata.warning: Small synthetic dataset. Initial labels from two reviewers; disagreements and source relevance finalized with AI assistance and adopted by the user. Not independent human-consensus gold. Some scenarios overlap development.

reference_provenance.dataset: 10 existing synthetic test cases, 15 fixed claims
reference_provenance.finalization: AI suggestions for four classification disagreements and source relevance adopted by user in conversation
limitations: Some scenarios overlap development examples. This is not a fully untouched holdout.
Annotation instructions and some label-boundary explanations were supplied by AI.
Source relevance is judged from existing curated summaries, not a fresh legal-source audit.
Final rag_verify labels are determined by structured evidence rules, not by independent model reasoning.

metadata.verification_decision_policy: rag_verify final labels are determined by structured evidence rules; not an isolated test of LLM reasoning
metadata.retrieval_query_policy: same description plus fixed claim texts as the RAG classification input
metadata.retrieval_empty_relevance_policy: queries with no relevant documents for a document kind are excluded from that kind mean
metadata.extraction_evaluation: NOT_RUN: fixed atomic claims supplied to every condition
